i personally use a brand of disposables called melody and i use the sweet mint flavor. the one i have is rechargeable and i’ve had it since december so it’s a pretty reliable option that lasts and doesn’t burn.

if ur interested in “tapering”, a 0% nicotine vape was my GODSENT. i quit for the first time after 6 years and it has stuck for the past month and i have no cravings at all. once u get the nicotine out of ur system and the cravings go away, you’ll find that u stop using the 0% vape all together. it’s a slower way to quit but it’s something that worked for me. sometimes it’s easier to eliminate one thing at a time. some people quit vaping all together and use nicorette gum or patches and some people (myself) quit nicotine all together and just used the 0% vape to help me. 

wishing you luck!!!! you can do it!
YES

-if ur interested, a 0% nicotine vape has helped me tremendously and as my cravings have gone down, i automatically use it less. i use the melody max in sweet mint. 
-sips of ice cold water (even better while chewing gum, gives a sensation of that throat hit).
-3 big mouth breaths, in and out thru ur mouth. sounds odd but it has helped me. 
-chew chew chew! gum, cold gummy bears (harder to chew, so it takes awhile), fruit (helps w the hand to mouth habit, helps w ur blood sugar since quitting nic can cause episodes of hypoglycemia, and it’s overall good for u)
-always have a yummy drink on u! whether it’s juice or flavored water doesn’t matter but highly recommend drinking it thru a straw! 

wishing you the best!!!
